# Coverage toolchain, kept apart from requirements-dev.txt so the lint and
# type pins are not dragged into a job that only measures. Pinned for the same
# reason they are: a tool release must not turn CI red on an unchanged commit.
#
# HASH-PINNED AS A WHOLE, not per pin: pip turns hash checking on for an
# entire resolution the moment any requirement in it carries a hash, so one
# hashed pin beside unpinned siblings refuses every install of this file
# with "hashes are required". Every artifact each release ships is listed,
# not the runner's subset, so the file resolves on whichever platform lifts
# it, and Dependabot regenerates the whole set on every bump. The same
# resolution-wide rule is why the audit gate's one pip-audit invocation
# cannot name this manifest any more (audit.yml's header carries the
# reason too).
#
# The install steps name the binary-only policy: --only-binary=:all: with
# --no-binary=PyYAML, so only PyYAML may build from source until a cp315
# wheel ships (yaml/pyyaml#981). Drop the pair with the first cp315 wheel.

# The shellcheck binary, as a package, so a requirements file can supply it:
# actionlint shells out to shellcheck for every `run:` block and reports
# nothing at all when it is missing. Pinned for the reason the two above
# are — a shellcheck release must not turn CI red on an unchanged commit.
#
# This line is the ONLY place the shellcheck version is written down.
# scripts/ci/install_lint_tools.py READS the pin and installs that version
# into the tool directory it puts on PATH, so every job that reaches the
# suites lints with the version named here — including a job that runs its
# interpreters by absolute path and therefore cannot see a console script
# installed in a virtualenv, and which used to resolve a shellcheck from
# its runner image at a version no pin named. A job that installs this
# file also has the binary; on those the installer's copy is first on PATH
# and is the same version, so the two routes cannot disagree.

shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 \
    --hash=sha256:b6a3fee28efda2e16e38d6e6d59faf7224300256456639727370d404730849e8 \
    --hash=sha256:6b88d0a244c82ed07e06a53e444da841f69330ca59ae15d4a66c391655dae7a0 \
    --hash=sha256:1b274df81de5b000ff78db433e7328b87e52e3c38481c60f8e488c3095beef05 \
    --hash=sha256:784156289ecb17e91c692cd783ab5152333309588cabb10032a047331c63e759 \
    --hash=sha256:5c620c88901e8f1d3be5934b31ea99e3310065e1245253741eafd0a275c8c9cc
